summary: Ansible 14.3: community.general keycloak_authentication, keycloak_authentication_required_actions and keycloak_authentication_v2 move to the middleware_automation.keycloak collection, become deprecated redirects in community.general 14.0.0 and are removed in 16.0.0.
questions: Where are the community.general keycloak modules moving?
What collection should I use for keycloak_authentication?
When will the keycloak redirects be removed?

answer_card.title: Keycloak modules move to middleware_automation.keycloak
answer_card.answer_md: The `keycloak_*` modules in community.general are moving to the `middleware_automation.keycloak` collection. In community.general 14.0.0 they become deprecated redirects, and the redirects are removed in 16.0.0. Install the new collection now and use its FQCNs, for example `middleware_automation.keycloak.keycloak_client`.
